audience: developers who run data syncs and connected apps in a Nango environment

useCases.title: Check integrations and connections
useCases.text: List the integrations of the environment, then the connections of one provider. Read a connection's status and errors, without tokens.

useCases.title: Check the status of syncs
useCases.text: Read the status and the last run of the syncs of one integration, or of one connection. Use the wildcard to read every sync.

useCases.title: Read synced records
useCases.text: List the records that a sync stored for one connection. Page through them, or list only the records changed after a time.

useCases.title: Pause, start or run a sync
useCases.text: Pause the scheduled runs of named syncs, start their schedule again, or run a sync once now.

useCases.title: Call a tool in a connected app
useCases.text: Run one enabled tool on a connection. The tool acts in the connected app, so it can create or change data there.
